projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Engine
projects.description: A production ML pipeline that scores subscription customers daily and flags at-risk accounts for the retention team.
projects.problem: The company was losing ~9% of subscribers monthly with no early-warning system, so retention outreach was reactive and untargeted.
projects.solution: Built a gradient-boosted ensemble on 40+ behavioral features, deployed behind a FastAPI service with a nightly Airflow scoring job and a Power BI dashboard for the retention team.
projects.impact: Reduced monthly churn by 23% within two quarters and lifted retention-campaign conversion by 3.1x versus the prior blanket-outreach approach.

projects.title: Real-Time Clickstream Pipeline
projects.description: Event-driven pipeline that ingests, transforms, and serves clickstream data for product analytics in near real time.
projects.problem: Product teams waited up to 24 hours for clickstream data to land in the warehouse, making experiment monitoring effectively next-day.
projects.solution: Designed a Kafka-to-Spark Structured Streaming pipeline landing curated tables in Databricks, orchestrated with dbt for transformation and tested with Great Expectations.
projects.impact: Cut data latency from 24 hours to under 3 minutes, enabling same-day experiment decisions and unblocking two A/B tests per sprint on average.

projects.title: Demand Forecasting Suite
projects.description: A hierarchical forecasting system for SKU-level demand across 300+ retail locations.
projects.problem: Manual, spreadsheet-based forecasting led to chronic overstock in slow-moving SKUs and stockouts in high-velocity ones.
projects.solution: Implemented hierarchical time-series forecasting (Prophet + LightGBM ensemble) with automatic reconciliation across store/region/national levels, scheduled via Airflow and surfaced in Tableau.
projects.impact: Reduced forecast error (MAPE) from 34% to 12% and cut excess inventory carrying costs by an estimated $1.2M annually.

projects.title: Support Ticket NLP Router
projects.description: An NLP classifier that automatically triages and routes inbound support tickets to the correct team.
projects.problem: Support tickets were manually triaged, adding an average of 6 hours to first-response time and misrouting roughly 1 in 5 tickets.
projects.solution: Fine-tuned a transformer-based text classifier on 80k historical tickets, deployed as a microservice integrated with the ticketing system's webhook, with a human-in-the-loop review queue for low-confidence predictions.
projects.impact: Cut first-response time by 71% and reduced misrouted tickets from 21% to 4%.

projects.title: Executive KPI Dashboard
projects.description: A unified executive dashboard consolidating revenue, growth, and operational metrics from six source systems.
projects.problem: Leadership pulled numbers from six disconnected tools before every board meeting, and figures frequently disagreed across teams.
projects.solution: Built a dbt-modeled semantic layer on Snowflake as the single source of truth, with a Power BI dashboard refreshed hourly and row-level security by department.
projects.impact: Eliminated reporting discrepancies entirely and cut board-prep time from ~2 days to under 2 hours per cycle.

projects.title: IoT Sensor Anomaly Detection
projects.description: An unsupervised anomaly detection system for predictive maintenance on industrial IoT sensor streams.
projects.problem: Unplanned equipment downtime cost the plant an estimated $40k per incident, with failures typically caught only after breakdown.
projects.solution: Trained an autoencoder-based anomaly detector on multivariate sensor telemetry, streamed through Kafka with alerts pushed to the maintenance team via a Grafana-backed monitoring stack.
projects.impact: Enabled predictive maintenance that reduced unplanned downtime by 34% in the first year of deployment.
